## Modules

- [AshScylla.Application](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Application.md): Application callback for AshScylla.
- [AshScylla.Connection](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Connection.md): GenServer wrapper for Xandra connections.
- [AshScylla.DataLayer.SchemaUtils](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.SchemaUtils.md): Shared schema utilities for table names, column analysis, and identifier quoting.
- [AshScylla.DataLayer.Types](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Types.md): Shared CQL type mapping and conversion helpers.
- [AshScylla.Extension](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Extension.md): AshScylla extension for `mix ash.codegen` and `mix ash.migrate` support.
- [AshScylla.Identifier](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Identifier.md): Centralized CQL identifier sanitization.
- [AshScylla.MigrationGenerator](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.MigrationGenerator.md): Generates CQL migration files from Ash resource definitions.
- [AshScylla.Migrator](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Migrator.md): Thin wrapper for executing CQL schema migrations via Xandra directly.
- [AshScylla.MixHelpers](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.MixHelpers.md): Shared helper functions for AshScylla Mix tasks.
- [AshScylla.ResourceGenerator](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.ResourceGenerator.md): Generates starter Ash Resource modules for AshScylla.
- [AshScylla.Schema](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Schema.md): Behaviour for schema migration modules loaded from `priv/migrations`.
- [AshScylla.Schema.Resource](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Schema.Resource.md): Struct representing a single resource's schema statements.

- [AshScylla.SchemaLoader](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.SchemaLoader.md): Loads and discovers schema migration modules from `priv/<repo>/migrations`.
- [MyApp.CustomRepo](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/MyApp.CustomRepo.md): AshScylla Repo for ash_scylla.
- [MyApp.ProdRepo](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/MyApp.ProdRepo.md): AshScylla Repo for my_app.

- Core
  - [AshScylla](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.md): AshScylla is a data layer for Ash Framework that uses ScyllaDB (via Xandra).
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.md): An Ash data layer for ScyllaDB using Xandra (direct CQL driver).
  - [AshScylla.Query](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Query.md): Represents a pending ScyllaDB query being built from Ash query expressions.

- Schema Helpers
  - [AshScylla.Migration](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Migration.md): CQL schema generation helpers for ScyllaDB.

- Data Layer Modules
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Batch](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Batch.md): Batch operations support for AshScylla using ScyllaDB's BATCH statements.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Collection](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Collection.md): Collection type (LIST, SET, MAP) optimization for ScyllaDB.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Compression](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Compression.md): Compression support for large payloads in ScyllaDB.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Dsl](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Dsl.md): DSL extensions for configuring ScyllaDB-specific options on Ash resources.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.FilterValidator](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.FilterValidator.md): Validates that filter columns are queryable in ScyllaDB/Cassandra.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.MaterializedView](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.MaterializedView.md): Materialized view support for AshScylla.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Pagination](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Pagination.md): Token-based pagination support for AshScylla.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.QueryBuilder](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.QueryBuilder.md): Query building functions for AshScylla data layer.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.QueryOptimizer](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.QueryOptimizer.md): Query optimization hints for ScyllaDB.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.SchemaMigration](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.SchemaMigration.md): Automatic schema migration support for AshScylla.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.SecondaryIndex](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.SecondaryIndex.md): Struct representing a secondary index definition on a ScyllaDB table.
  - [AshScylla.DataLayer.Udt](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.DataLayer.Udt.md): User Defined Type (UDT) runtime support for ScyllaDB.

- Repo Helpers
  - [AshScylla.Release](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Release.md): Release task helpers for running AshScylla migrations in production
without Mix installed.
  - [AshScylla.Repo](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Repo.md): Configuration module for AshScylla using direct Xandra connections.

- Performance
  - [AshScylla.PreparedStatementCache](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.PreparedStatementCache.md): ETS-based prepared statement cache for ScyllaDB/Cassandra queries.

- Observability
  - [AshScylla.Telemetry](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for AshScylla.

- Error Handling
  - [AshScylla.Error](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Error.md): Common error types and utilities for AshScylla.
  - [AshScylla.Error.ScyllaError](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/AshScylla.Error.ScyllaError.md): Comprehensive error handling for ScyllaDB-specific errors.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_scylla.gen](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.Gen.md): Generates a schema migration file from Ash DSL resource definitions.
- [mix ash_scylla.gen.repo](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.Gen.Repo.md): Generates an AshScylla Repo module for your application.
- [mix ash_scylla.generate_migrations](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.GenerateMigrations.md): Generates CQL migration files from Ash resource definitions, and stores snapshots.
- [mix ash_scylla.migrate](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.Migrate.md): Runs pending CQL migrations and applies resource schema changes.
- [mix ash_scylla.new_template](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.NewTemplate.md): Generates an Ash Resource template backed by AshScylla.
- [mix ash_scylla.setup](https://ash-scylla.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshScylla.Setup.md): Sets up the ScyllaDB keyspace for AshScylla.
